brickwright:command-desc: Place converted Lego/voxel schematics into the world
brickwright:no-schematics: No schematics found in {0}. Convert a build with tools/ldr2vs.py and drop the .json there.
brickwright:not-found: Schematic '{0}' not found. Use /bw list to see available schematics.
brickwright:pasted: Placed '{0}' ({1}x{2}x{3}, {4} blocks). Use /bw undo to revert.
brickwright:undo-modified: Cannot undo: {0} block(s) of the pasted structure have been modified since pasting. Undo only works on an untouched paste.
brickwright:set: Position set. The structure will stay; Undo can still remove it.
brickwright:nothing-pending: Nothing pending. Place a schematic with a direction button first.
